title: Paella making experience!
text: When I went to the paella class alone, it was one-on-one! Since I like cooking, I asked various questions and you taught me in detail! I mastered the tips for making it at home! Thanks to the very kind and humorous staff, I had a wonderful time enjoying wine!!
author: Climber645564

title: Best Paella Cooking Class in Barcelona!
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 

Rice to Meet You was easily one of the highlights of our entire trip to Barcelona! From start to finish, the experience was absolutely fantastic.

Luis was amazing—warm, welcoming, entertaining, and incredibly knowledgeable. His passion for cooking, Spanish food, and the culture of Spain came through in everything he shared. He didn’t just teach us how to make paella; he made the whole experience fun, personal, and memorable. We learned so much while laughing, cooking, eating, and enjoying every minute.

author: 525michelleq

title: Fantastic cooking experience
text: We were a mixed group of 2 mums and 3 older teen boys. Mums keen … boys not so, but we all had a brilliant time! Host was very warm and welcoming… restaurant/ kitchen very organised and we all loved eating the individual paella dishes we cooked ! We were also given lovely tortillas on tomato bread and a delicious dessert. Wine flowed throughout the experience (carva and 2 different white wines … all delicious). Would totally recommend!
author: Venture19124278098

title: If you can go, do it!
text: Excellent guided experience to make my own paella, they provided wine and the people were very friendly, I made a friend in the workshop
author: 551cristopherc

title: An experience that must be repeated
text: The paella workshop was an excellent experience. We learned to make it step by step, with a good pace and clear explanations, and the best part is that you cook it yourself and then eat your own paella. The atmosphere is super pleasant, perfect for going in a group or as a couple. The friendly and fun service at all times, and the quality-price ratio is unbeatable for everything it includes. We left delighted and eager to return. Highly recommended.
author: R4970DCalessandraf

title: HILARIOUS AND HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
text:
HILARIOUS EXPERIENCE!!!

I went with a friend and we ended up making friends with everyone who was there. 
A very fun idea to cook your own paella and see how each paella has its own unique touch. Outstanding service from Luis and Leo, who are wonderful ❤️
author: carlosleal177

title: Recommendation if you like good service and quality/price
text:
It is an excellent experience, the service is a perfect 100 points!! Not only do they help you with what you want, but they also make you feel at home! 🤩

And also in the afternoons they offer workshops for you to make your own paella!! Incredible!!
author: 621carlitosb

title: Unforgettable paella workshop
text: It was a fantastic day. Leo and his partner made the experience of cooking a paella unforgettable; it was my first time. Thanks to their way of guiding us, we ended up with some incredible paellas.
